name: BentoSpaces
author: James John
description: Workspaces as little bento boxes in the bar — a live mini-map of each workspace's windows — plus macOS-style trackpad control: 1:1 workspace swipes, Mission Control on swipe up, Shift + swipe to carry windows, pinch to fullscreen and optional edge resize.

barWidget.description: Workspace mini-maps, trackpad gestures and Mission Control
